firmware_setup: Power off; hold Volume Up, press and release Power, keep holding Volume Up until the Surface UEFI appears.
boot_menu: Hold Volume Down while pressing Power to boot from USB once, or move "USB Storage" to the top of Boot configuration in the UEFI.
secure_boot: Surface UEFI -> Security -> Secure Boot -> Change configuration -> None.
notes: REPLACEMENT KERNEL 6.18.21-gbrunch-sp7 (same ACK revision as Google's kernel): i915 for Gen11 graphics,
built-in AVX-VNNI emulation, Surface Aggregator (battery), SOF Ice Lake audio, IPTS touch with iptsd.
Google's kernel modules are not used on this profile.
GRUB default entry admits SMBIOS vendor 'Microsoft Corporation', product/board 'Surface Pro 7'.
Cameras: IPU4P front ov5693 / rear ov8865 via libcamera softISP (the Microsoft IPU4P firmware is
not redistributable: local builds add it with assemble --local-files from surface/fetch-ipu4p-firmware.sh). IR camera, autofocus and suspend are not configured.
status: 2026-11-09/10 on the device: display, setup wizard, touch/pen, Wi-Fi (AX201 Qu-c0), Bluetooth firmware, USB Ethernet,
battery/charger, speakers, internal microphone, 3.5 mm headphones and headset microphone work.
Cameras: front and rear photos and video (recording and playback) work; no rear autofocus or IR camera.
